# ICP: Independent dental clinics, 2-10 chairs
*v1 — Independent dental clinics losing front-desk hours to missed appointments*

## Must-have
- Independent dental clinic with 2 to 10 chairs (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- Buyer: the owner dentist; where there is one, the practice manager (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Nice-to-have
- Family-owned (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Disqualifiers
- Hospital groups (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Anti-ICP
- none yet

## Top pains (ranked)
1. Patients miss appointments and the front desk spends hours on reminder calls (confidence: validated; source: founder, website)

## Buying triggers
- The clinic opens a second location (confidence: validated; source: founder)
- The clinic loses its front-desk manager (confidence: validated; source: founder)

## Changelog
- v1 (2026-10-27): first version, because of the website and a four-answer interview
